title: Windows Job Object lifecycle qualification
objective: Prove on native Windows CI that Cotra can create a Job Object, set JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE through extended limit information, and close the handle without exposing process execution authority.

authority_delta.process: No child launch and no external process authority

invariants: Job Objects are treated as lifecycle/resource controls and never as the sole sandbox
The probe assigns no process to the Job Object
The probe closes the Job Object handle on success and after configuration failure
process.spawn and PowerShell remain absent from policy and MCP

acceptance.claim: Native Windows test creates an unnamed Job Object.
Native Windows test sets JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE using extended limit information.
Native Windows test closes the Job Object handle successfully.
Non-Windows builds remain cfg-isolated from Win32 linkage.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu CI and Governance pass.

done_when: The Job Object lifecycle primitive is proven on Windows CI and merged with post-merge verification. Process assignment and child launch remain successor grains.
